name: Math to LaTeX
description: Select math, or click Copy LaTeX on an equation, and get its LaTeX: from the document's own tags, the paper's arXiv source, an open-access journal version, or read from the fonts.
author: speedyf

commands.title: Math to LaTeX: Copy Selection as LaTeX
Math to LaTeX: Copy Equation as LaTeX

settings.title: Use the arXiv source
settings.description: For a paper with an arXiv id, fetch its TeX source from arxiv.org and copy the author's own LaTeX.

settings.title: Use open-access journal versions
settings.description: For a paper with a DOI, look for its open-access full text on Europe PMC and copy the formulas from there.

settings.title: Prefer
settings.description: "Fonts only" never uses the internet: it reads the document's tags and its fonts, nothing else.
